final.role: Token filter that folds accented characters to ASCII (e.g. acai from açaí) for accent-insensitive matching
final.evidence: Converts alphabetic, numeric, and symbolic characters that are not in the Basic Latin Unicode block to their ASCII equivalent ... açaí à la carte -> [acai, a, la, carte]
